symmetry.name: Symmetry: The Seventeen Ways a Pattern Can Repeat
symmetry.v1_note: SEQUENCE CANDIDATE #23 (assemblage 2026-07-07). The 17 wallpaper groups — translate, reflect, rotate, glide, and their closure. Drafted concept-first (R-023), cast entirely from the existing loom/mill/pattern families. Proposed spine position: between transformation and array_tutorial (transforms -> GROUPS -> grid).
symmetry.truth: A pattern is not a picture — it is a rule performed. There are exactly seventeen ways a flat pattern can repeat: the one census in this book that CLOSES. The Alhambra's artisans exhausted it centuries before group theory existed to count it.
symmetry.qfep_connection: Symmetry groups are pure F at its most honest: the complete, finite catalog of possible orders. The closed census of 17 is the deliberate counter-rhyme to fractional dimension and incompleteness — order's one finished victory, and its exact size.
